subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Charles Ponzi: The Name Behind the Scheme
description: A fast breakdown of Charles Ponzi: The Name Behind the Scheme for builders.

hook.text: Charles Ponzi didn't invent the pyramid scheme. He just ran it so well they named it after him.

buildup.text: His 1920 scheme promised 50% returns in 45 days using international postal reply coupons.

discovery.text: He paid early investors with new investors' money. The math made it inevitable it would collapse.

twist.text: At his peak, Ponzi received $250,000 a day. Adjusted for inflation, that's $4 million daily.

climax.text: After prison, he was deported to Italy, moved to Brazil, and died penniless in 1949.

punchline.text: His name lives forever. His fortune didn't survive a decade.

quiz.question: What happened to Charles Ponzi after his scheme collapsed?
options: He was imprisoned, deported, and died penniless
He fled and was never caught
